Name: Butterflies in Pelican Town
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds more butterflies to the town and the forest using Custom Companions.[/size]

[size=5]Installation:[/size]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url][size=3]2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url]
3. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=3]3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)[/size]
[size=3]4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder[/size]
[size=3]5. Launch your game and enjoy! 

[/size][size=5]Compatibility:[/size]
[size=3]NOT tested with Stardew Valley Expanded or other mods that edit the town or forest, but it wouldn't break your game either way. 

[/size][size=5]Mods used in the screenshots:[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url] by grapeponta [/size]
